name: How is the project budget reported to me over time?

mainEntity.name: How is the project budget reported to me over time?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically receive periodic budget snapshots or cost reports that summarize original contract amounts, approved changes, allowances, and remaining contingency so you always know where you stand.
